## Checklist (required)

- [ ] **Provenance**: every prompt marked Reported links a public source. Anything else is marked Representative.
- [ ] **LeetCode links**: canonical `leetcode.com/problems/<slug>/` URLs, slug checked, difficulty matches LeetCode, Premium marked.
- [ ] **Why**: each new problem row says why it is relevant.
- [ ] **Original code**: practical solutions are my own, standard library only, and `python solution.py` passes.
- [ ] **No confidential material**: nothing covered by an NDA.
- [ ] **Scope**: coding rounds only.
- [ ] Internal links are relative and resolve.
